description: The case's committed/ folder holds a project skill named verify-spec, a test double that changes nothing and replies with a report whose FR-002 row is met with no path:line and no passed test. parse_reply.py calls it invalid. build-phase implements T-1.2 and T-1.3 with the real implement-task, retries the verify once, gets the same report, and stops: it never copies the rejected report's Tally and never runs the verify task. Without the parse step it would see no gap and finish done.

must_match.why: an invalid verify report twice ends the run
the rejected report's Tally is never copied

must_match.pattern: ^Stopped: verify-spec gave no usable reply twice$

must_match.why: the verify report went through the script
the subagents loaded the test double; without this the run proves nothing

must_not_match.why: the Tally of the report the script rejected
the verify task does not run without a usable report
the real verify-spec ran instead of the test double, so the run proves nothing
it never pushes, merges, or rewrites history

manual: git log on reading-time/phase-1: the T-1.2 and T-1.3 commits and nothing after them; T-1.4 is still Todo.
